devon: Helio Health follow-up: they need GPU tier recs, # reserved GPUs for a 3mo commit, autoscale template, and a simple reserved vs burst cost sketch before signing. Can we draft quickly?
marta: Quick clarifiers: peak chat qps? median/p95 tokens? embedding QPS and nightly batch size?
sanjay: From POC: chat peak ~220 qps for ~30m, median tokens ~40, p95 ~420. Embeds steady ~120 qps (1536d), nightly 3M vectors over ~6h. Using 33B q4.
marta: For p95 <200ms: A100-80 works for 20-33B; H100 if 70B+. With q4 assume ~2x throughput. Ballpark: chat -> 1 A100 handles ~150qps p95; so reserved=2 + burst to 3 for 220 peak. Embeds -> 1 GPU covers nightly ingest (~140 qps sustained). Recommend reserved 3 GPUs (2 chat,1 embed) + burst credits + KV preheat.
ops-bot: AUTOSCALE TEMPLATE: min_replicas: reserved_capacity; triggers: queue_depth & gpu_util; burst_pool enabled; cooldown 60s; fallback to smaller quantized model.
sanjay: Runbook notes: KV preheat 30-45m before windows, warmup curl loop, cooldown 60s, queue-depth throttling, canary fallback.
li-legal: We can offer Dedicated or Private for enterprise commits. KMS available in Private. I'll start the security questionnaire; need their SOC artifacts within 48h.
devon: Action items: marta -> sizing + cost sheet (conservative/aggressive). sanjay -> autoscale + preheat runbook. li-legal -> questionnaire draft. I'll send summary to customer and schedule a 1hr walkthru in 48h.
